scope: read-only active power-sheet and isolated BQ25792 candidate review

refs: Fuel_Gauge_Power: U13/U16/U17 pins 1,2,4,5; U5 pins 3,5,7,8; 3V_AO; BAT_PACK
findings.condition: BAT_PACK is nonzero but below 3V_AO pull-up; below 2.5V MAX17048 is below its stated operating supply; below 1.65V TS5A3167 is outside recommended VCC range
findings.action: Keep U5 disconnected until its supply is valid; default the signal switches off or use a safe 3V_AO-side isolation/level-translation scheme.

refs: USB_PD: U19 pins 7,8 and U11 pin 24 / USB_AUX_5V; Fuel_Gauge_Power: U20 pins 3,5,6,2,7; U12 pins 1,3,5
findings.condition: Fixed 5V LDO fed by nominal 5V USB; weak-source output, startup load and dropout margin are not bounded
findings.action: Qualify U19/U12/AO startup at weakest allowed USB source and actual MCU/I2C load.

refs: candidate Battery_Charger: U4 pins 13,17,24; Q100/Q101/Q102/Q103; SW101
findings.supported_good: Default-off CE, POR HIZ hold and series external ship-FET routing are consistent with intended sequence.
findings.condition: POR HIZ sample below 1.08V implies cached 100mA clamp; no documented resampling on release. Host must clear EN_EXTILIM and set/read back source-specific IINDPM, while handling reset/watchdog/source changes; DP/DM detection mux and host enumeration are pending. Candidate R102 is displayed 4.7k but has MPN/LCSC for 220R; 4.7k is the BQ25792 1S/750kHz Table 9-1 setting, and 220R is not a listed valid profile. REG14 SFET_PRESENT resets to 0 and locks SDRV_CTRL/ship control until the host sets it to 1.
findings.action: Correct R102 MPN/LCSC; have startup set/read back SFET_PRESENT=1 before using Q103 ship control; keep candidate isolated until source-aware current, reset/watchdog and CE behavior are implemented and verified.

supported_good: TPS2116 active pin mapping: USB_AUX_5V VIN1/MODE, SYS_RAW VIN2, output to U12 VIN/EN; domains remain distinct.
TS5A3167 powered-off isolation applies at VCC=0 absent-pack condition; low nonzero pack behavior remains open.
Candidate 1S SYS max 4.55V under BQ25792 specified condition is below TPS2116 5.5V recommended input ceiling.
